What do food and the table say about this place?
At the table Shared dishes, a host who keeps filling your bowl, and what to do with your chopsticks.
A table of shared dishes At a family meal the food sits in the middle, and everyone eats from it together.
Why does the host keep filling your bowl? Serving a guest is one of the clearest ways a host shows hospitality.
Chopsticks and the rice bowl A small habit at the table that some guides link to how the dead are remembered.
Eating at a street-food stall Order at the front, sit where there is room, eat first and pay on the way out.
